revision_summary: Surgical r2 pass. Pessimistic design review = NEEDS_REVISION (4 test-guard fixes); optimistic = APPROVE (2 non-blocking folds). The design CORE was independently verified correct by BOTH reviewers and is UNCHANGED: Q6_K (210 B, d LAST @208, no dmin, signed int8 scales @192) + Q5_K_M (176 B, d@0/dmin@2/scales12@4/qh32@16/qs128@48) layouts; the pure-source signed technique (f32_from_u32(sc_u); if>=128 -=256.0) with zero new builtins; Q6_K-first phasing; the Q6_K non-fusion decision. No perf question re-opened; no TFLOPS gate. All r2 edits are to test-guard STRENGTH and Coder-facing references only — NOT to layouts, signedness, kernels, or the AT range.

fixes_applied.change: AT-2811 now REQUIRES the golden to be the FULL 256-element expected f32 array and to explicitly assert coverage of all four quant-groups q1..q4 (two ql slices x lo/hi nibble x qh bit-pairs 0-1/2-3/4-5/6-7), BOTH 128-halves h=0/h=1, the is=l/16 boundary (l=15 vs l=16), a negative int8 scale, and q extremes — matching AT-2816's rigor so a group-3/half-1/is-boundary decode bug cannot pass a partial golden.

AT-2823 now gates the coopmat Q5 kernel against the q5k_dequant_matmul_f32accum_cpu ORACLE (f16-weight-rounded, apples-to-apples with the coopmat f32_to_f16 staging) at combined <= 1e-3, and REMOVES the false 'mirror AT-1803 bit-identity' framing (that cited a ~1e-6 floor for what is a ~5e-4 cross-precision comparison). Cross-decode consistency is already proven transitively by AT-2819 + AT-2822.

Reworded 'source references only reserved Q4_0 builtins' (literally false — kernels call band/bor/shl/lshr/gid/coopmat_*/workgroup_barrier) to 'referenced-builtin set SUBSET-OF the corresponding Q4_K_M baseline kernel's builtin set — no addition', a mechanically checkable zero-NEW-builtin anchor. AT-2821 documents the 4096-byte arithmetic ((512+512)*2 f16 + (256+256)*4 f32).

Section 5 points the Coder at crates/axc-driver/tests/common_matmul.rs::q4km_dequant_matmul_cpu as the bit-exact (native-f32) template (was incorrectly 'mirror q4km_oracle.rs'), while still reusing the metric fns from q4km_oracle.rs. Added a kernel-matching-associativity requirement ((d*sc_f)*q_f / (d*sc)*nib5-(dmin*m)) so max_diff==0 holds BY CONSTRUCTION per the review's bit-exact-safety proof; section 5.1 inline comment updated.

optimistic_folds.change: Section 4.1 now MANDATES a line-by-line inline comment in the Q6_K kernel mapping sc[8h+is+{0,2,4,6}] and the q1..q4 reassembly to section 3.1's formula lines (the most transcription-error-prone part).

Section 6 adds a golden-fixture-provenance rule for AT-2811/AT-2816: PREFER a real ggml byte-dump cross-check; hand-computed-from-formula accepted as an annotated fallback documented per-ggml-field; QA MUST record which was used.

correctness_oracle: Per format: (1) CPU dequant oracle byte-exact vs a golden superblock — PREFERABLY a real ggml byte dump, hand-computed-from-formula as an annotated fallback; the Q6_K golden is the FULL 256-element array covering all four quant-groups x both halves x the is=l/16 boundary + a negative scale (AT-2811/2816); (2) portable GPU kernel BIT-EXACT (max_diff==0) vs the native-f32 CPU matmul ref (mirroring common_matmul.rs::q4km_dequant_matmul_cpu with kernel-matching FP associativity) at K=256 with order-matched f32 accumulation (AT-2814/2819, mirror M3.1 AT-1520); (3) large-K + coopmat paths gated by max_rel_diff_combined <= FROZEN 1e-3 (condition-aware, mirror AT-1780/1800..1802). 1e-3 NEVER loosened. The Q5 coopmat kernel is cross-checked APPLES-TO-APPLES against the f16-rounded q5k_dequant_matmul_f32accum_cpu oracle (AT-2823), NOT against the full-f32 portable kernel (that would carry a ~5e-4 f16-weight-rounding gap).

edge_cases: Q6_K field order: d is the LAST 2 bytes (offset 208) and there is NO dmin — do not copy the Q4_K_M (d,dmin-first) header.
Q6_K signed int8 scales in [-128,127] and quants (q-32) in [-32,31] — fixtures MUST include negatives (an all-positive fixture passes a broken unsigned kernel).

Bit-exactness by construction: for all u in [128,255], f32_from_u32(u)-256.0 == (i8)u as f32 exactly, and q_u in [0,63]/sc_u in [0,255] convert exactly — so the pure-source sign path yields IDENTICAL f32 to a signed reference PROVIDED the CPU oracle uses the same (d*sc_f)*q_f associativity as the kernel (section 5 requirement).
Q5_K_M qh bit index = 2*chunk + is_hi (0..7) into qh[(k%64)%32]; a wrong index passes chunk 0 but fails chunks 1..3 (AT-2816 covers all 8).
Block-stride constants 210 (Q6_K) / 176 (Q5_K_M) must not be copied as 144; runtime multi-superblock fixtures (AT-2814/2819) catch a wrong stride.

AT-2814/2819 fixtures should keep every product w*x AND every partial sum exactly f32-representable (integer-valued, |partial| < 2^24) so max_diff==0 is order-independent-safe (mirror AT-1520); fixture builders should assert it.
Portable kernels use f32 x/y (no coopmat) -> run on Lavapipe; the Q5 coopmat kernel typed-skips on Lavapipe (CoopMatUnsupported) like M3.6.
50 GB test-executable limit respected: portable K<=2048, single coopmat A/B correctness test at M=N=64 up to K=14336 — far under the limit.
out_of_scope: No fused coopmat Q6_K matmul — Q6_K's 16 signed int8 scales + no-dmin + 210-byte layout are NOT a clean drop-in for the M3.6 (row x 8-sub-block) cache; the portable kernel proves Q6_K dequant; a fused Q6_K tensor-core kernel is a distinct deferred design.
No new leader-tuning / TFLOPS campaign (M3.13 closed it); NO perf gate asserted.
No loosening of the FROZEN 1e-3 tolerance.
No new SPIR-V capability/extension beyond the Q4_K_M set.
